name: Fate/Dear Night
source:
The past fades away eventually. What remains is the friend and love connections build up over the time. The Holy Grail War is over, so main characters have time enjoying themselves.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
过去终会淡去，唯有岁月中结下的友情与爱情留存下来。圣杯战争已经结束，主人公们终于能够放下纷争，享受属于自己的悠闲时光。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
